ret: 4 training days (press, dead, bench and squat) holding 8 exercises, over block weeks train ×3, deload, repeating.
Block weeks: train, train, train, deload, repeating. If you miss a session the plan waits: the next session is still the one you missed. Loads on a 5 lb grid.
Rotation: Each training week: Day press, then Day dead, then Day bench, then Day squat.
Attendance (from the rotation): Train at least 4 times in each 7-day window (from your start day). If you don't train for 21 days, attendance stops counting until your next session.

press: Wendler 5/3/1 on Overhead Press: three waves off a training max that starts at 90% of your estimated max, AMRAP last set, deload week; after each cycle's deload add 5 lb, or propose a reset to 90% of TM if any AMRAP fell short.

dead: Wendler 5/3/1 on Deadlift: three waves off a training max that starts at 90% of your estimated max, AMRAP last set, deload week; after each cycle's deload add 10 lb, or propose a reset to 90% of TM if any AMRAP fell short.

bench: Wendler 5/3/1 on Barbell Bench Press: three waves off a training max that starts at 90% of your estimated max, AMRAP last set, deload week; after each cycle's deload add 5 lb, or propose a reset to 90% of TM if any AMRAP fell short.

squat: Wendler 5/3/1 on Barbell Back Squat: three waves off a training max that starts at 90% of your estimated max, AMRAP last set, deload week; after each cycle's deload add 10 lb, or propose a reset to 90% of TM if any AMRAP fell short.
pressBbb: Boring But Big: 5×10 on Overhead Press at 50% of the press slot's training max; three sets in deload weeks.
deadBbb: Boring But Big: 5×10 on Deadlift at 50% of the dead slot's training max; three sets in deload weeks.
benchBbb: Boring But Big: 5×10 on Barbell Bench Press at 50% of the bench slot's training max; three sets in deload weeks.
squatBbb: Boring But Big: 5×10 on Barbell Back Squat at 50% of the squat slot's training max; three sets in deload weeks.
1 training day (R) holding 1 exercise, over block weeks train, repeating.
Block weeks: train, repeating. If you miss a session the plan waits: the next session is still the one you missed.
Rotation: Each training week: Day R, then Day R, then Day R.

Attendance: Train at least 3 times in each 7-day window (from your start day); leave at least 2 days between workouts. If you don't train for 21 days, attendance stops counting until your next session.
run: Couch to 5K: nine weeks of run/walk sessions, three a week; move to the next week after three sessions with every run completed, and repeat the week if you have to stop a run.
Hands on weekReached: the run slot's programme week when the program ends.
Juggernaut realization week on {lift}: an AMRAP at the training max; the training max then rises by {perRep} for every rep past {standard}
Reads your estimated max (kept on file; ignored once older than 56 days).
Starts with training max = 90% of your estimated max for {lift}; written by session, owner.
Plan: {lift}: 1 set of as many reps as possible (at least {standard}) at your training max.

After each session: Set training max to whichever is known first: (1) your training max plus {perRep} for every rep past {standard} on the AMRAP set (the reps you logged on “amrap”) [= {perRep} × ((the reps you logged on “amrap” minus {standard}), never below 0 reps)]; (2) your training max.
{sets} of {lo} to {hi} on {lift}, the last set extended rest-pause; add {inc} once the rest-pause set totals {total}
Starts with working weight = nothing; written by session, owner.

Plan: {lift}: {sets} of {lo} to {hi} at your working weight; finish with a rest-pause (as many reps as possible (at least 3 reps) resting 15 s, then as many reps as possible (at least 2 reps) resting 15 s).

After each session: Set working weight to whichever is known first: (1) the earned weight [= (if the reps across every mini-set of “work” is at least {total}: your working weight plus {inc}; otherwise: your working weight)]; (2) your working weight; (3) the best load you logged on “work”.

expected.ret: ({now} plus the sets to add next week given {soreness} and {pump} [= (by {soreness}: 0 → (by {pump}: 0 → 2 sets; 1 → 2 sets; 2 → 1 set; 3 → 1 set); 1 → (by {pump}: 0 → 1 set; 1 → 1 set; 2 → 1 set; 3 → 0 sets); 2 → 0 sets; 3 → 0 sets)] (0 sets if unknown)), capped at {mrv}.

Set tm to whichever is known first: (1) your tm plus {perRep} for every rep past {standard} on the AMRAP set (the reps you logged on “amrap”) [= {perRep} × ((the reps you logged on “amrap” minus {standard}), never below 0 reps)]; (2) your tm.
Set tm to whichever is known first: (1) your tm plus {perRep} for every rep past {standard} on the AMRAP set (the reps you logged on “amrap”); (2) your tm.
